defects.repro: parse_price('١٢.٥','EUR') and parse_price('EUR ١','EUR') return a value (1250 and 100). Section 6 says a text with no number is a ValueError. The pattern uses \d, which matches any Unicode digit. The same \d was in the pre-change pattern, so this is not a regression.
defects.fix: Use [0-9] instead of \d in PRICE_RE, or compile it with re.ASCII.
